findings.description: The missing-argument check changed from truthiness to `is None`, so an empty `match=""` is now accepted instead of raising TypeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes match="" with message omitted, for example from an empty config default. Previously `not match` was true, so the constructor raised 'missing 1 required argument'. Now `match is None` is false, so no error is raised, and re.compile("") matches every exception string. The predicate therefore retries on any exception, silently and without warning. The same change also means message="" is accepted and only matches exceptions whose str is empty.
